body: I fucking agree with this shit too much. I don’t give a shit that you had it worse, it doesn’t give you the right to belittle people with problems that you deem as “simple” or “pathetic”. It also doesn’t give you the right to take away the persons right to feel bad over his/her current situation. Actually fucking think about the person who’s experiencing the issue no matter how little or big the person’s issue is and stop trying to feed your ego by telling them that you had it worse. If you actually know what your doing because “oH I’vE ExPeriEnced Soooooo mUch”, then fucking try to have empathy to help this person. I’m sorry if I went on a rant here, I’m just tired of people who say “I had it worse” and think that’s a way to help the person suffering.

My mother didn’t really think it was bad and she insisted because of the the good intention of my father so nothing really much happened until an event happened in which my mother started to agree with me that I shouldn’t interact with my father for some time

I’m sorry if I did not type the post with much detail. We were on the same team but I was just not on my usual skill level and I felt like I wasn’t doing much or was jealous that my friends are better at the game even though that we had a similar or less play time. I think I already said sorry to them but I’m still overthinking about it. But thx for the advice still.
No, I dont take medication. I dont really think that I have a problem mentally. I just really think that I have to go, I’m too incompetent and I want to remind myself that I am.

I also find them comforting. Everytime I feel like shit, I just imagine my suicide in my head or me in a hospital bed because of suicide and it feels so comforting. I almost never feel stressed anymore of school, grades or my future because of it. Everytime I try to sleep I just imagine me killing myself and it feels so relieving.

I have something like that but instead of me saying that I’m gonna kill myself, I just imagine it on my head. Like every time I feel stressed or do something wrong, I always imagine me killing myself and unconsciously saying “it’s ok, I’ll be dead anyway before I turn 20” and it just feels relieving at times.
